title: Farm vehicles and livestock
epochs: 40 on Open Images, then 30 more with drone pictures added
data: Open Images V6/V7: 1,800 real photos, mostly from the ground; plus drone pictures of cattle and sheep from above (Roboflow Universe: aerial-cattle-detection, counting-cattle, aerial-sheep)
note: Finds cattle and sheep well from straight above. Tractors, cars and trucks were learned from ground-level photos only: from above it finds few of them. Teach them with your own flight pictures (Teach new objects).
license: Weights derived from Ultralytics YOLO11n (AGPL-3.0). Training data: Open Images (photos CC BY 2.0, boxes CC BY 4.0); aerial-cattle-detection by cattle-psyty and counting-cattle by arthurmessias on Roboflow Universe (CC BY 4.0); aerial-sheep by riis on Roboflow Universe (Public Domain).
